info.name: Pioneer DDJ-800
info.author: Mix Two
info.description: MIDI mapping for the Pioneer DDJ-800, derived from the rekordbox MIDI message table. The owner tested most controls on a DDJ-800 on 2026-10-26. Some controls are not tested.

option.label: Start in vinyl mode
option.description: When this option is on, a touch on the top of the jog wheel scratches the track. The controller sends its own VINYL state. That state replaces this option.

option.label: Jog resolution (ticks per revolution)
option.description: One full turn of the platter moves the track by 1.8 s, as on a record at 33 1/3 rpm. The DDJ-800 sends 6480 ticks for each turn. Increase this value if the track moves too fast when you scratch. Decrease it if the track moves too slowly.

option.label: Input selector controls passthrough
option.description: When you set the input selector of a channel to LINE or PHONO, Mix Two starts passthrough for that deck. Set the matching input in Preferences > Sound Hardware first.
